prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1397; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a closed distal radius fracture of the wrist. Over six visits, care consisted of immobilization, serial clinical examinations, and follow-up imaging. Radiographs and the physical examination clearly confirm the fracture, and the described mechanism of injury is consistent with the findings. The patient reports no prior injury to this wrist or the surrounding area, and no earlier treatment for the region is known. Management followed a typical course: initial splinting, progression to a removable brace as healing advanced, and gradual reduction in visit frequency as symptoms and range of motion improved. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At last follow-up the fracture showed expected healing, and the patient was released to graduated activity with home exercises and return precautions reviewed.
